objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other controlled content that undergoes creation, editing, review, release, and archiving processes.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Short code assigned to a document based on its type

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state of the document in its lifecycle such as editing, review, released, or archived

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document indicating revision history

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the document version becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date after which the document is no longer valid

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Person responsible for creating and signing the document

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Additional person with change rights on the document

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Person who checks the document for technical and formal aspects

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Person responsible for approving and releasing the document for distribution

attributes.name: translator
attributes.description: Person responsible for translating released document content

attributes.name: reader_group
attributes.description: User group assigned to view the document

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT systems referenced or relevant to the document

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational units for which the document applies

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Defined period after which document validity must be reviewed

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period for which archived documents are retained before physical deletion

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Area of applicability or coverage of the document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document attached to a main document that undergoes the same release cycle and versioning as the main document.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Supplementary content attached to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and can be published independently.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A managed request to amend an existing released document without affecting its current version or version history.

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A system-generated request to review whether a document remains valid for continued use.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to invalidate a document that no longer has validity and must be withdrawn from circulation.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to revalidate and restore a previously invalidated document during the archiving period.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned specific roles and permissions for document access and workflow participation.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: A user group that retains read access to archived documents while all other users lose access.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons designated to receive a document and participate in acknowledgement or email notification workflows.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Initial creation of a new document object in the system with selection of document type and optional template

evts.name: edit_document
evts.description: Modification of document content or properties after creation

evts.name: upload_content
evts.description: Attachment of external files or documents to a document object

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatic system conversion of document content to PDF format for web display

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Designation of a person as the author with creation signing rights

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Designation of additional persons with change rights on the document

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Designation of persons to check document content for technical and formal aspects

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Designation of persons responsible for approving and releasing the document

evts.name: assign_translator
evts.description: Designation of persons responsible for translating released document content

evts.name: assign_reader_group
evts.description: Assignment of user groups with read permissions for the document

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Definition of user groups and persons to receive the document and participate in workflows

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Addition of a controlled document attachment to a main document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Marking of an attachment for archiving when no longer relevant to a document version

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: Addition of supplementary content to a document not subject to release cycle

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: Removal of additional information content from a document

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Creation of a managed request to amend an existing released document

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Integration of a change proposal into a new document version

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Marking of a change proposal as finished and no longer displayed in the document

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: Start of the 3-step approval process for a document by author or co-author

evts.name: sign_as_author
evts.description: Electronic signing by the document author in the first workflow step

evts.name: sign_as_reviewer
evts.description: Electronic signing by reviewers confirming technical and formal checks

evts.name: sign_as_releaser
evts.description: Electronic signing by releasers approving document for distribution

evts.name: reject_in_review
evts.description: Negative completion of review task canceling workflow for subsequent participants

evts.name: reject_in_release
evts.description: Negative completion of release task canceling workflow for subsequent participants

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatic publication of document to readers after successful release

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Creation of new editing version when a released document requires updates

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System-generated creation of request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity_by_releaser
evts.description: Releaser confirmation of extended validity with information to other participants

evts.name: extend_validity_by_multiple_participants
evts.description: Extended validity check carried out by author, co-authors, reviewers and releaser

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Creation of request to invalidate a document with no additional validity

evts.name: override_by_releaser
evts.description: Releaser invalidation of document with information to other participants

evts.name: override_by_multiple_participants
evts.description: Three-step override process with initiator, reviewers and releasers

evts.name: archive_document
evts.description: Withdrawal of authorizations for invalidated document except for archive group

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Request to re-validate and restore a previously invalidated document

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Approval of reactivation request creating new version of archived document

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Sending email notification of new document version to distribution list recipients

evts.name: distribute_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Sending email workflow task requesting active confirmation of document acknowledgement

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Active confirmation of document acknowledgement by recipient

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translation of released document content into another language

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Workflow approval of translated document version for publication

o2o.description: Documents can reference other documents through the references attribute
Attachments are controlled documents attached to and released with main documents
Additional information supplements documents but is not subject to release cycle
Change proposals belong to and are displayed in their associated document
Distribution lists contain assigned user groups for document notification
Archive group is a specific user group retaining access to archived documents

o2e.description: Documents are created through document creation events
Document content and properties are modified through edit events
External content is attached to documents through upload events
Document content is converted to PDF format through conversion events
Author role is assigned to document through assignment events
Co-authors are assigned to documents through assignment events
Reviewers are assigned to documents through assignment events
Releasers are assigned to documents through assignment events
Translators are assigned to documents through assignment events
Reader groups are assigned to documents through assignment events
Distribution lists are maintained for documents through maintenance events
Attachments are created and linked to main documents
Attachments are archived when no longer relevant to a version
Additional information objects are created and attached to documents
Additional information can be deleted directly from documents
Change proposals are created for documents by authorized users
Change proposals are implemented into new document versions
Change proposals are marked complete after editing is documented
Release workflow is initiated for documents by authors or co-authors
Document authors provide electronic signature in first workflow step
Assigned reviewers provide electronic signatures confirming checks
Assigned releasers provide electronic signatures approving release
Reviewers reject documents during review step
Releasers reject documents during release step
Documents are published to readers after successful release
Released documents are revised creating new editing versions
Validity extension requests are system-generated for documents
Validity extension is confirmed by releaser through event
Validity extension involves multiple participants through event
Override requests are created by authorized users for documents
Documents are invalidated by releaser through override event
Documents are invalidated through multi-participant override event
Documents are archived after override through archiving event
Reactivation requests are created for archived documents
Archived documents are reactivated through confirmation event
Distribution lists trigger email notifications of document release
Distribution lists trigger acknowledgement workflow tasks
Recipients confirm acknowledgement of documents
Released documents are translated into other languages
Translated document versions are released through approval event
